reviews.title: not my favorite
reviews.text: I downloaded this app hoping it will help me come up with notes to write my song, and it turned out to be really disappointing because it will not do that. however, i’m not saying the app itself is bad, just not great. i recommend chordify if you are trying to do what i am. Chordify offers more that just the piano as well.
